data.narrative:
Stegra is a Growth-stage climate and energy company founded by Carl-Erik Lagercrantz and Harald Mix that has raised $7.0B+ to date. The valuation universe consists of 8 private peers in Climate & Energy alongside 1 public comparable (LNZA), though the private peer set—which includes Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix—lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage depth to support traditional peer multiples analysis.

Given data constraints, valuation relies on stage-progression methodology applied to the $7.0B raised proxy. A typical Growth-stage step-up multiplier of 1.2x yields an implied valuation of $8.4B, reflecting progression toward later-stage financing or exit value. This method is the sole quantitative anchor available; peer-median analysis was not applicable due to insufficient narrow-set comparables at matching stage and valuation tier.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $7.1B (low) to $9.7B (high), with a median of $8.4B. Key uncertainties include the absence of granular peer multiples specific to Stegra's stage and subsector, reliance on historical step-up assumptions that may not reflect current market conditions or capital efficiency trends, and limited visibility into revenue scale or unit economics. Additional transaction or financing data from direct comparables would materially improve precision.
